reimport-changed.says: A pod that already holds a person's record is given the same file with 10 of its laboratory results changed (a value and the time the source changed it), as when a hospital has corrected some results since the last pull.
reimport-changed.total: Opening a pod that already holds the record, importing the file with 10 laboratory results changed and asking a first page of the lab results: what a person waits for after a hospital updates some results.
